easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
